text: Quest Global is a privately held engineering services firm headquartered in Singapore. In August 2023 global investment firm Carlyle agreed to acquire a 'significant minority stake' in the company, through funds managed and advised by entities affiliated with Carlyle Asia Partners.
short: Quest Global is a private Singapore engineering firm; Carlyle acquired a significant minority stake in 2023.

source.name: Quest Global press release - Carlyle and Quest Global Enter into a Strategic Partnership
source.quote: Carlyle will be acquiring a significant minority stake in the company. Equity for this transaction will come from funds managed and advised by entities affiliated with Carlyle Asia Partners.
